# First Google Search run

Copy this into Cursor Agent after installing and configuring the plugin. No key is included.

> Use the serp MCP tool serp_google_search for one search results request. I checked the current Ace Data Cloud price and balance. Set number 3, page 1, search_type search. Set query to site:cursor.com plugin marketplace. Run once, inspect the returned result or error, and do not repeat the call automatically.
